s1.syndrome_frame: Rapidly enlarging mass behind the ear with parietal bone invasion and meningeal involvement
salient_findings: Hyperdense meningeal mass with parietal bone invasion on noncontrast CT
Heterogeneously enhancing lesion on Gadolinium-enhanced MRI
key_facts: 76-year-old woman
History of appendicitis, torsion of an ovarian cyst pedicle, and uterine myoma
No neurological deficits or systemic symptoms
Normal or negative laboratory studies, including complete blood counts, metabolic panel, and viral serology for HIV and Epstein-Barr virus
Noncontrast CT showed a 5-cm hyperdense meningeal mass
Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed a heterogeneously enhancing lesion
Cerebral angiography demonstrated a vascular tumor supplied by the middle meningeal artery
Tumor was extradural with skull destruction and no intradural involvement
Histology showed a malignant spindle cell neoplasm
Positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin
Negative staining for Epstein-Barr virus

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant spindle cell neoplasm with positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial clinical diagnosis based on imaging and meningeal involvement

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Part of the differential diagnosis for a dural mass

shortlist.label: Metastatic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Considered due to skull invasion and rapid growth

shortlist.label: Hemangiopericytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vascular tumor supplied by the middle meningeal artery, consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The tumor's malignant spindle cell morphology and positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin are consistent with leiomyosarcoma, a type of smooth muscle tumor.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Although initially considered due to dural involvement, the histology and immunostaining pattern do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Negative viral serology and lack of specific lymphoma markers make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Metastatic carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunostaining pattern are not typical of metastatic carcinoma.

rejected.label: Hemangiopericytoma
rejected.why: Although a vascular tumor, the histology and immunostaining pattern are more consistent with leiomyosarcoma.
